paragraphs.chinese:
这一集接着上一集，全家终于到了夏威夷。每个人心里都有一个完全不同的“理想假期”，而大多数人最后都不得不改一改自己的想法。

Phil 一心想把夏威夷之旅变成自己和 Claire 当年没过成的蜜月。两个人当年因为 Claire 怀了 Haley，很快就在法院把婚结了，所以 Phil 一直觉得欠她一个真正浪漫的版本。Claire 却说，带着三个孩子旅行根本不叫蜜月，对她来说更像一场天气比较好的出差。

Phil 还是说服她把孩子交给 Mitchell 和 Cameron，两个人去成人泳池待一会儿。Claire 好不容易开始慢慢放松，Haley 却突然出现，说要跟几个刚认识的青少年去旁边另一家酒店玩。Claire 第一反应当然是跟过去，但 Phil 劝她难得放手一次，相信女儿。

几个小时以后，Alex 下来告诉他们，Haley 正在楼上喝醉了吐。Claire 立刻开始怪自己，觉得不该压下直觉。她去照顾 Haley，也提醒她这次有多幸运，事情没有发展成更糟的结果。Haley 问喝酒是不是每次都会这么难受，Claire 连停顿都没有就回答“对”。严格来说不完全是真的，但 Claire 非常乐意让她暂时这么相信。

Phil 原本的“补蜜月”计划看起来已经彻底没戏，不过他还有最后一个惊喜。他突然想明白，两个人真正缺的其实不是蜜月，而是一场婚礼。于是他在酒店安排了一个小小的仪式，全家都来了，Phil 和 Claire 重新交换誓言。

与此同时，Jay 刚到夏威夷时只想吃、喝、躺着什么都不干。结果哥哥打电话提醒他，他们父亲去世时就是六十三岁，而 Jay 现在也刚好这个年纪。这句话把他吓得不轻。Jay 突然开始健身、游泳、划船、吃健康餐，好像一个周末就能把年龄倒回去。

Gloria 很快受不了，因为 Jay 已经把度假搞成军训。Jay 最后用力过头，在往吊床上躺时闪了腰。Phil 找到他时，他就卡在那里。Jay 终于承认，自己是真的害怕会在和父亲一样的年纪死掉。Gloria 理解这种恐惧，但也提醒他，活着如果完全不享受生活，好像也没什么意义。

Mitchell 的问题正好相反。他恨不得每一分钟都出去看东西，Cameron 却只想躺在泳池边。更尴尬的是，Cameron 其实这些年一直在假装自己喜欢冒险旅行，因为 Mitchell 喜欢。Mitchell 最后一个人去了薰衣草农场，回来以后还在生气，甚至故意编出自己在那里碰见 Elton John 的故事，只为了让 Cameron 后悔没去。

后来 Mitchell 终于试了一次 Cameron 式度假：坐下来、喝点东西、把脚翘起来，什么也不做。他居然发现感觉好得不得了。可两个人也放松得太彻底，直接把 Lily 忘在了电梯里。Gloria 发现后把孩子送了回来。更夸张的是，后面去香蕉种植园时，他们居然又把 Lily 弄丢一次。

这趟旅行依然乱七八糟：Haley 做了件蠢事，Jay 把自己吓得半死，Mitchell 和 Cameron 甚至把孩子弄丢了两次。可 Phil 居然还是成功把结尾变成了那场他和 Claire 当年从没拥有过的婚礼。
paragraphs.english:
This episode continues the family’s trip to Hawaii. Everybody arrives with a different idea of what a vacation should be, and almost all of them have to change it.

Phil wants Hawaii to become the honeymoon he and Claire never had. They got married quickly at a courthouse because Claire was pregnant with Haley, so Phil sees this as a chance to finally do the romantic version properly. Claire points out that traveling with three kids doesn’t feel like a honeymoon. To her, it’s a business trip with nicer weather.

Phil gets her to leave the kids with Mitchell and Cameron and go to the adults-only pool. Claire slowly starts to relax. Then Haley shows up and says she wants to go to another hotel with teenagers she just met. Claire wants to follow her, but Phil talks her into trusting Haley and letting go for once.

A few hours later, Alex tells them Haley is upstairs drunk and throwing up. Claire is furious with herself for ignoring her instincts. She looks after Haley and reminds her how lucky she is that nothing worse happened. When Haley asks if drinking always makes you feel this terrible, Claire says yes without hesitation. It’s not exactly true, but Claire is happy to let her believe it.

Phil’s honeymoon idea seems finished, but he has one last surprise. He realizes the thing they really missed wasn’t the honeymoon—it was the wedding. He arranges a small ceremony at the hotel, and the whole family gathers while Phil and Claire renew their vows.

Meanwhile, Jay starts the trip wanting to eat, drink, and do nothing. Then his brother reminds him that their father died at sixty-three, Jay’s age now. That scares him. Suddenly Jay is working out, swimming, rowing, and eating healthy food like he can reverse aging in a weekend.

Gloria gets annoyed because he’s turning the vacation into boot camp. Jay pushes too hard and throws out his back getting into a hammock. Phil finds him stuck there, and Jay admits he’s scared of dying at the same age his father did. Gloria understands, but reminds him that staying alive should still include enjoying himself.

Mitchell has the opposite problem. He wants to sightsee every minute, while Cameron wants to lie by the pool. Cameron has actually been pretending for years that he loves adventurous travel because Mitchell loves it. Mitchell goes to a lavender farm alone, comes back annoyed, and even invents a story about meeting Elton John to make Cameron jealous.

Later, Mitchell finally tries Cameron’s version of vacation. He sits down, gets a drink, puts his feet up, and discovers that doing nothing feels amazing. Unfortunately, they get so relaxed that they accidentally leave Lily in an elevator. Gloria finds her and brings her back. Later, at a banana plantation, they lose her again.

The trip is messy: Haley makes a stupid choice, Jay scares himself, and Mitchell and Cameron literally lose their baby twice. Somehow Phil still manages to end it with the wedding he and Claire never had.
